policy: Approved features never disappear silently. Removing an entry fails the Feature Registry gate; an intentional removal is a status change to 'deprecated' with deprecation.approved_by (owner), date and migration. Emergency safety / legal fixes may change behaviour with an auditable 'exception' entry in history. Status words in the Command Center: WORKING / DEGRADED / DISABLED / FAILED / UNVERIFIED.

features.name: Universal Decision Brain (search readiness, one next question)
features.purpose: Understand the need from the whole conversation and decide whether a search is justified now.
features.expected_behavior: decide() returns mode, state, search_ready, ONE next_question and a consolidated search_subject; known facts are never asked again; a product noun alone never triggers cards.

features.name: Reasoning before results (guidance + goal planning)
features.purpose: Every reply genuinely helps first; cards support the answer, never replace it.
features.expected_behavior: Guidance with the user's own numbers, labelled estimates, goal / resource planning when something must get done, at most one question; a false results claim drops only its sentence.

features.name: One-time advice memory
features.purpose: Advise once, respect the decision, keep helping.
features.expected_behavior: A concern repeats only for new information, an explicit ask or a critical risk; the ledger is kept per conversation.

features.name: Result Board (above the conversation, same Home screen)
features.purpose: Show relevant results without covering the conversation, input or avatar.
features.expected_behavior: hidden / loading / expanded / minimized pill / restored / pinned selection / stale / archived; sized from the real Home column height; minimize and restore reflow the chat; a retired deck is archived and restorable.

features.name: Result Contract v2 (sections, honest empties)
features.purpose: One versioned backend-to-app result contract for every source.
features.expected_behavior: /deals/discover and /deals/{id}/matches return sections, conversation_state, answer.may_claim_results and matches; a failing source empties only its own section.

features.name: Online / local / mixed discovery channel
features.purpose: Route discovery to the channel the user asked for.
features.expected_behavior: An online ask never shows nearby shop cards and always runs the online search; a local ask skips the web search; a channel switch never leaves old cards posing as the answer.

features.name: Structured reply rendering
features.purpose: Readable answers in any language: headings, points, bold, tables, links -- never raw markup.
features.expected_behavior: Assistant replies render their structure; plain replies stay plain; speech gets plain words.

features.name: Photo / video / document understanding
features.purpose: Understand media sent with or without words, without assuming a purchase.
features.expected_behavior: One analyze endpoint; media alone is explained, never searched; honest failures.

features.name: Continuous voice (Sarvam STT / TTS)
features.purpose: Speak naturally until Stop; replies spoken in the conversation language.
features.expected_behavior: Recording ends on the user's Stop; long silence (8 s) and 2 min are safety limits; Telugu preserved; no markup spoken.

history.change: no stop on a thinking pause

features.name: Header location control (the one place to change location)
features.purpose: One location control; the companion menus never duplicate it.
features.expected_behavior: Header chip changes the place; companion ring / floating menu offer no Location action.

features.name: Truthful provider readiness + Check now
features.purpose: Admins see real provider state, never key presence.
features.expected_behavior: LIVE only after a real answer; QUOTA_EXHAUSTED / NEEDS_CONFIGURATION / ERROR distinguished; no secrets.

features.name: Assistant feature health + self-heal verified recovery
features.purpose: Real user-facing outcomes and recoveries that are proven, not assumed.
features.expected_behavior: No traffic = unknown; an applied fix is UNVERIFIED until evidence shows VERIFIED / NOT_RECOVERED.

features.name: Universal Advisor (configurable decision fields)
features.purpose: Category questions from Command Center configuration, never keyword scripts.
features.expected_behavior: A required unanswered field holds results unless the user asks to see them; the brain's answer is kept with the advisor's one question.

features.name: Owner-only encrypted database backup with verified restore
features.purpose: Take a recoverable backup of the production SQLite database without Railway volume backups.
features.expected_behavior: Owner key only (staff refused); read-only snapshot; AES-256-GCM with a passphrase that is never stored; a restore into an isolated database must pass integrity_check + row counts + SHA-256 before the file is offered; one-time download; no row contents in any response, log or audit entry.
